# Research Source Matrix

What each **built** research source does at runtime, derived from `lib/domain/research/sources.ts` and the adapter registry. The roadmap of every source considered (with value ratings) is `work-tracking/RESEARCH-READER-PLAN.md` §5.

## Sources

| Source | Roles | Access | Whose key | Rate limit | Resolves | Enriches | Default on |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [OpenAlex](https://openalex.org) (`openalex`) | discover, resolve, enrich | key | app-or-user · `OPENALEX_API_KEY` | 10/1s | openalex, doi, pmid, pmcid | references, citedBy, related, copies, retraction | yes |
| [Semantic Scholar](https://www.semanticscholar.org) (`semantic-scholar`) | discover, resolve, enrich | key | app-or-user · `SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY` | 1/1s | s2, doi, arxiv, pmid, pmcid | references, citedBy, related, tldr, copies | yes |
| [Crossref](https://www.crossref.org) (`crossref`) | discover, resolve, enrich | email | app · `RESEARCH_CONTACT_EMAIL` | 10/1s | doi | retraction | yes |
| [Unpaywall](https://unpaywall.org) (`unpaywall`) | resolve | email | app · `RESEARCH_CONTACT_EMAIL` | 10/1s | doi | copies | yes |

## Terms

- **OpenAlex:** Data CC0. Free daily allowance per key; verify current quota (plan §5.1).
- **Semantic Scholar:** API licence requires attribution; works without a key at a shared, lower limit.
- **Crossref:** Metadata is open; the contact email joins the polite pool (a project address, never the user's).
- **Unpaywall:** Free with a contact email; ~100k calls/day.
